name: Dodo Payments
summary: A developer-oriented Merchant of Record focused on SaaS and digital products, with particular attention to sellers in India and other emerging markets.

pricing.headline: Public marketing pricing starts at 4% + $0.40; international cards add 1.5%, subscriptions 0.5%, and disputes $30.
pricing.assumptions: Public marketing rate. Dodo's contractual pricing document still describes a different base rate, so sellers must confirm their signed terms. Refund, payout, PayPal, BNPL, and FX fees can also apply.

sellerCoverage: Eligible digital-product businesses can apply from supported payout countries, subject to underwriting, product, and sanctions policies.
buyerCoverage: Dodo documents selling into more than 220 regions with taxes and local availability handled by market.
products: SaaS, software, AI products, digital downloads, courses, memberships, and other approved digital products.

features.checkout: Hosted checkout, payment links, embedded components, and developer APIs.
features.subscriptions: Recurring billing, trials, plan changes, usage-based billing, and customer self-service.
features.invoicing: Tax-aware receipts and billing records are included; confirm B2B invoice workflows for your markets.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, wallets, BNPL, and supported local methods vary by market. Dodo currently says PayPal is paused for new transactions.
features.payouts: Net proceeds are paid to approved seller payout accounts after taxes, fees, refunds, and risk adjustments.

responsibilities.note: Dodo acts as legal seller for supported transactions and handles applicable sales taxes.
Dodo operates the payment and dispute layer while sellers must cooperate and follow product policies.
The seller remains responsible for delivering and supporting the underlying product.
The seller must account for net payouts and its own company-level taxes.

strengths: Public entry pricing below many 5% MoR offers
limitations: Younger operating history than established MoRs
Official marketing and contractual pricing are not fully aligned
Eligibility, PayPal availability, and payout coverage require confirmation
avoidIf: You require a decades-long operating history
You need physical-goods support or guaranteed country coverage
